blogs.title: What Makes 1‑Bit LLMs a Game Changer?
blogs.description: Demystify the concept of 1‑bit (ternary) weights and explain how BitNet‑b1.58 turns every parameter into “-1, 0, or 1”. Highlight the physics of integer addition versus floating‑point multiplication, the resulting energy and latency savings, and why 1.58 bits—thanks to the extra zero—offers a sweet spot between compression and performance.

blogs.title: Building and Training a BitNet‑b1.58 from Scratch
blogs.description: Walk through the key engineering steps: the absmean quantization, the 8‑bit activations, the LLaMA‑like backbone with RMSNorm and SwiGLU, and the removal of biases. Show readers how to set up a training pipeline with 100 billion tokens, what hyperparameters matter, and how to monitor bit‑wise statistics during training.

blogs.title: Why 1‑Bit LLMs Beat 16‑Bit Models in Speed and Memory
blogs.description: Translate the empirical results into everyday terms. Break down the latency, memory, and throughput gains (e.g., 2.7× faster, 3.5× lighter) across 3B to 70B models. Include visual charts or interactive plots that compare perplexity and zero‑shot accuracy, making it clear when a 1‑bit model can replace or surpass its full‑precision counterpart.

blogs.title: Energy Efficiency of 1‑Bit LLMs: Numbers That Matter
blogs.description: Zoom in on the energy story. Explain how integer addition consumes orders of magnitude less power than FP16 multiplication, and walk through the 71.4× savings on 7 nm chips for a 7B model. Tie this to real‑world implications such as data‑center cost reductions and carbon‑footprint mitigation.

blogs.title: Scaling Laws Revisited: 1‑Bit LLMs Across Model Sizes
blogs.description: Introduce the new scaling equivalence table: 13B b1.58 is as efficient as a 3B FP16, etc. Show readers how to choose a model size that balances performance against hardware cost, and discuss the implications for future LLM research and deployment strategies.

blogs.title: Beyond LLMs: 1‑Bit Models for MoE, Long‑Context, and Edge
blogs.description: Explore the broader ecosystem. Describe how 1‑bit weights facilitate Mixture‑of‑Experts, explain the memory‑friendly KV cache enabling longer contexts, and outline the possibilities for running large LLMs on mobile and edge CPUs. Conclude with a look at the next generation of 1‑bit‑optimized hardware.
